scope: Four staged routing R3 modules; not consolidated integration acceptance or deployment review.

verified.policy: Exact candidate subset retained. Claude remains manual-only; workers reject media before JEV; media candidates narrowed to MiMo. Cold order preserved unless baseline has qualified samples and unique cost/latency dominator exists. Unmeasured nonbaseline candidates do not block qualified comparisons.
verified.measurements: observations uses completed records with exact model,task,current task_source and modality_counts. Cost/latency must be finite,nonnegative and paired per same record; cost absent is not zero. MIN_SAMPLES3. Missing/invalid/baseline-unmeasured/tie/tradeoff preserve cold start.
verified.media_partition: All user/assistant history parts counted; text follow-up to attachment remains image/audio/video. Mixed types and multiplicity retained. stamp stores counts/task only, not attachment bytes/URLs. Unknown shapes unclassified rather than invented text-only.
verified.admission: partition checks host counts/kinds, nonnegative ints excludingbool and consistency. Catalog defaults text-only; host media_integrated flag permits declared modalities only for nonworkers. This flag does not replace transport permissions/consent.
verified.regressions: Existing router source-binding/packet/ACOM projection, wallet settlement and no-retry paths preserved in inspected diff. No scientific/context package changes in this four-module slice.
verified.tests: 24 independent offline tests passed with staged pure modules/AST excerpts; DNS/socket/subprocess denied, writes limited to own mission workspace. Runtime server not imported; end-to-end choice/dispatch not tested.

integration_pending: Merge metric stamp hook at Evaluation.stream and observe; pass actual transmitted full message list, not latest text only, and exclude legacy rows.
Pass request_media summary to choose(media=summary) and host-owned media_integrated only after integration tests. Confirm unavailable/unconsented MiMo does not grant fallback media dispatch.
Server/media final transport must validate MIME/content/limits, consentv2,rights/wallet and final provider payload independently; routing metrics are not attachment validation.
Automatic limits advertise image/audio/video unconditionally in this candidate; final server must only expose/use after actual media transport integration and tests.
Final consolidated plan and hashes, server/motores offline tests, multimodalR4 and binary vendor path/license review not yet delivered for acceptance.
limits: Observed cost/latency are not quality or causal benchmarks. Matching media counts does not match size,duration,resolution or workload.

next_action: Main completes server/multimodal integration and submits immutable final plan; reviewer evaluates concrete final state before accept/deploy.
